name: Antipathy/Sympathy

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 PHB; compare every number with the book before setting checked_against.

components.m: a mix of vinegar and honey

targets.description: a Huge or smaller creature or object

summary: For 10 days a creature or object repels (Frightened) or attracts (Charmed) a kind of creature you name that fails a Wis save.
text: Creatures of the named kind save when they come within 120 feet of the target; repelled ones must use their movement to get as far away as they can, drawn ones to get as close as they can and can't willingly leave once within 5 feet. An affected creature that ends its turn more than 120 feet away saves again, ending it on a success and becoming immune for 1 minute.
